column1: # wsamplepow x randtour grid on harder instances. 200 seeds, 900s.
# wsamplepow=p draws the random source from the segment tree with probability
# proportional to ddfw weight^p: p=1 linear (compiled default), p=2 squares the
# weight (concentrates draws on heavy sources), p=3 cubes it (harder still).
# randtour=t runs a t-way tournament over candidate draws (t=1 = pure
# proportional, no tournament). Only the draw distribution differs across rows;
# top-K selection, the weight floor, and the transfer amount all still use the
# Grid: p in {1,2,3} crossed with small t, to locate the best peaking/tournament
# combination on the hard ntil instances (p1 = wsamplepow=1 was consistently the
# worst regime on ntil-45/47/49; p2 and uniform tournaments won).
